dataset: ZOZO Open Bandit Men, both policies, all original rows
target: Expected binary click at position 1 under position-local consistency, no slate interaction; historical context population only
reference: Official OBP production-prior BernoulliTS, 1000000 Monte Carlo draws seed 12345, top-3 ranks; Random to BTS position 1 estimates vs BTS observed click mean; full-period and daily diagnostics. Modern reimplementation of reference protocol, not exact paper table replication.
reward_model: Empirical-Bayes action x user_feature_0 click rates, strength 100, action prior strength 100; global prior training clicks only; no affinity, timestamps, source row or other policy outcome as predictor
selection: Largest validation paired DR normal lower bound vs uniform; deterministic name tie break; freeze selected policy before test
nuisance: 3-fold row-level cross-fit reference descriptive benchmark; chronology model frozen at end train for validation/test, no final-outcome fitting
uncertainty: Row-iid normal intervals and paired differences explicitly conditional approximations; 1000 hour-cluster bootstrap replicates sensitivity only; seven-day source cannot satisfy release horizon
independent_outcomes: Unobserved item rewards never manufactured for real-data claims. Simulation oracle results separately labeled.
